slice.description:
Key - slice dimension, i.e. data column name
Value - slice specification

Flexible slice specification with the following options:
Range: min inclusive and max exclusive
Values: list of exact values to slice
Positional Indices: list of exact positions to slice

For "Range" and "Positional Indices", the implicit order will be the order of declaration (this will be specific
to the key and type of data), NOT the default sort order (lexicographical or otherwise) for the objects.

For "Values" and "Positional Indices", the order of the returned slice will match the order specified in the provided array.
